title: devx SDK docs to-do - daily scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SDK docs / tutorial fixes (quick notes)

2026-03-06 (Fri) - morning dump

Top priorities
- [ ] Finish short Quickstart overhaul for JS SDK (reduce friction for first 5 min)
    - Remove heavy config section, move advanced options down
    - Add single-command runnable example that returns streaming generations
    - Validate code sample with latest client v0.9 changes (auth param rename)
- [ ] Add note about model routing behavior when model not available (error vs fallback)
- [ ] Draft sample app for "embedding-based semantic search" using Redwood hosted embeddings + simple FAISS example
    - Make sure to include index build snippet and batching guidance

Notes / gaps I keep seeing in support threads
- Confusing: "model alias" vs "model id" in hosted API docs — multiple users tried to pin model but thought alias was same as version tag. Need a small glossary table.
- Streaming sample in README still shows old sdk.stream() API; new API is client.responses.stream(...). Update across repo and docs.
- Tutorial "Deploying to Dedicated" link broken in sidebar (404). Probably ref link mismatch after nav restructure.

Sample code to sanity-check (JS quick demo)
- Make snippet that works in one paste:
  import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/devx-sdk';
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
  // streaming generation
  const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood/t-base', input: 'Write a haiku about latency.' });
  for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk.text); }

Questions / TODOs for sync with infra/product
- Confirm expected error behavior when routing to fallback model: does token billing use requested model or fallback? (Ping @Mikaela)
- Is there a recommended quantized model we should reference in the quickstart for low-cost dev testing? (Devon has suggestions)

UX / Docs polish items (small)
- Add keyboard-focused copy for "Try in Playground" button (aria-labels)
- Expand Troubleshooting section: common auth errors, CORS issues for web apps, sample curl + curl-with-session examples
- Add tiny screenshot for Console > Models page showing where to find model alias

Planned sample app outline: "Semantic FAQ search"
- README: short pitch + commands to run locally (node 18+), env vars (RW_API_KEY), install deps
- scripts: index.js builds embeddings, saves index to ./data/faiss.index, starts Express server with /search endpoint
- docs: performance tips (batch embeddings, shard sizes, when to persist index to S3)
- eval: include small prompt set + expected top-3 answers for regression checks

Unresolved / blockers
- Need final wording from legal on data retention blurb for examples that index customer content (quick copy: "Do not index PII in sample datasets")
- Sample app licensing: which open-source license do we default to for templates? (Probably MIT but confirm)

Quick links to triage later
- GH PR to update streaming API examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/412
- JIRA ticket for sidebar link fix: JIRA-DELTA-238
- Confluence guide for tutorials: confluence:devx-sdk-tutorials

Notes to self (short)
- Keep snippets under 20 lines, copy must be actionable
- Avoid advanced topics in Quickstart; link to "Advanced config" page instead
- Run through fresh-account flow tomorrow morning (use staging key) to catch auth UX issues

End of dump. Will turn into checklist and PRs by EOD.

-- Sam
